da-non-sequitur.evidence: (S↔P column of prop:shell-closure-normal-form row) Ref resolves only in sibling `.lean:119`: `∃ nf, IsNormalForm (nf.map Prod.fst)`, discharged by applying the unconditional axiom `division_terminates_unique` (:89) to `[]`; the conclusion never mentions 𝒩(p,n) and is witnessed by the empty support (vacuous). (ii)-(iv) are encoded only as hard-coded decimal tables (`hecke_energy_step`, `dominant_coeff`) and two `rfl` palindrome checks (A=4,6), not ∀ p=n. Under open PR #7915: it turns both axioms into theorems proved by `[]`/`∅` and documents the vacuity, but does not encode the claim. Proof: (i) argued (any division remainder is reduced; trivial). (ii) is false as worded: md:14 identifies the histogram with "the Poincaré polynomials of S₄, S₆", but S₄'s is 1,3,5,6,5,3,1 (sum 24) while the A=4 histogram is 1,3,4,3,1 (sum 12); the sibling's own comment (:171-184) says so. (ii) for all p=n, "p≠n is not a palindrome", (iii) and (iv) are finite computations with decimals inside the proposition, never proved. Empirical: "boundary N≥Z−1 matches the nuclear valley of stability" (prf:86)
